verdict.rationale: LangSmith's docs say users can annotate outputs and gather feedback using annotation queues or inline annotation, and they list human review as a supported evaluator type. That covers the core of the story: sending outputs to human queues for review and labeling. Automation rules are mentioned, but the docs don't explicitly tie them to sending traces into queues. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of rule-based or automatic routing of traces into annotation queues, detail on queue configuration (rubrics, reviewer assignment, labeling schema), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
